title: Bad UX
body:
The ‘start of the day’ feature is really not intuitive and I still don’t understand how it works. I set it to 2am, but I am still asked at 22pm on whether to attribute the action to the current day or tomorrow.
And for some tasks the streak is reset when midnight is coming.
Idk I even checked my timezone and looked in the settings to write about the feature - maybe I understood something incorrectly. But no, it is supposed to work exactly as I expect it to.
Without this feature half of my tasks always have 1-2 streak and the game effect is completely lost
